failure_pattern_definitions.waiting_dominated: STAY actions at least half of episode steps
failure_pattern_definitions.repeated_movement: at least 20 movements; at least half arrive at a previously visited cell
failure_pattern_definitions.periodic_tail: last 60 positions repeat exactly with a period of 2..12 and include multiple cells
failure_pattern_definitions.closest_static_remaining_steps: BFS distance to final goal, ignoring dynamic obstacles; a diagnostic, not a safe dynamic path length

aulc_definition: Trapezoidal integral at actual sparse evaluation steps, normalized by 50000; not continuously observed performance.
